//: The AI voices EasyVocal ships: blends of the RVC v2 base model's speaker vectors (nobody in particular). The base model (MIT) was trained on the CSTR VCTK Corpus (CC BY 4.0). Generated by BundledVoices.Write (tools/EasyVocal.AiPack: `voices`). Ids are persisted: never rename one. mix = [speaker index, weight] (weights sum to 1); targetHz = the voice's natural pitch (the input is moved there).
source: RVC v2 base generator f0G40k (lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI), speaker vectors blended
licence: Voice data: CC BY 4.0 (CSTR VCTK Corpus). Model: MIT (RVC-Project).
attribution: Derived from the CSTR VCTK Corpus (Junichi Yamagishi, Christophe Veaux, Kirsten MacDonald; University of Edinburgh, Centre for Speech Technology Research), CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.7488/ds/2645 — modified: a blend of several speakers' voice vectors in the RVC v2 pretrained model (MIT, RVC-Project), so the voice belongs to no single speaker.
